name: 10-v618-still-operation-lock
body:
Still picture workshop

Workshop open failed. Read its error; saved data was not replaced. Audio recovery can be attempted after closing the dialog.

Back to this edition’s game

Upload an original, choose an exact map and world, then save and preview its assignment.

This workshop reads the installed packs for this exact game edition, or the dev channel when served from source. Close that game before editing. Fresh flights use the assigned revision. Saved flights and earned Collection pictures keep their original choice; changing an assignment does not replace them.

Real local storage: Open local media upgrades this address’s shared image/story/music database to version 4. It is not a sandbox. Older game audio readers cannot reopen it. Export your music in the old game first if needed, then close old tabs. Original MP3 and image bytes are retained; no downgrade or automatic deletion is provided.

Open local media
Close local connections
Try Dawn Signal

An optional eight-second silent story for the base game’s First Signal mission in FPV Front. Download both example files, then use Open local media to review and restore them. Nothing is installed until you explicitly restore it.

Download Dawn Signal picture
Download Dawn Signal story
Example identity and hashes
Restore the picture file first. Preserve current assignments unless you intend to replace them. Then choose Reload saved media and installed maps; the other editing tools remain disabled until this reload.
Restore the story file with Restore incoming bindings.
Return to this edition’s game, choose base-game First Signal and FPV Front, then win a fresh attempt. Choose Victory story to Play or Skip. Saved flights and previously earned pictures retain their earlier choices.
Soundtrack recovery

The compatible audio adapter shares the same version 4 manager. If the saved data can be verified, prepare an unchanged .rlsound backup. Still pictures are not included. Corrupt metadata can require a separate recovery tool; it is never replaced with an empty library here.

Prepare soundtrack backup

Keep original image files outside browser storage. Inside the workshop, Prepare originals download creates a verified .rlmedia backup; use its separate Download originals link. To restore, choose a file and assignment policy, review it, then explicitly Restore. Game progress, saved flights, packs and audio-only files need their separate backups. This workshop can bind an optional story to an exact saved picture. Keep video originals in a separate .rlstory backup. Authoring and previews do not award pictures.

Keyboard: Tab/arrows and Enter, Escape to close. Controller: join, D-pad to move, South to choose, East to return. File picking and text entry use the browser/OS controls; no controller virtual keyboard is supplied.
